coordinates: 0-based; every end field exclusive; frozen fields are copied verbatim

support_counts.n_metric_assessable: count of metric-only lateral/localization assessability flag, independent of Stage B full body score
support_counts.n_primary_eligible: metric-only assessability AND (Stage B only) full assessability
support_counts.n_denominator_pooled: primary-eligible AND AUC defined AND denominator defined
support_counts.n_*_defined_all_positions: metric mathematical validity before full-process score selection

pooling: framewise endpoint median, never ratio of separate scan medians
zero: valid zero AUC is retained; invalid numeric endpoints are NaN with reason
